title: Channel-wise Vector Quantization: Native 1D Visual Tokenization with Learnable Ordering
abstract: arXiv:2605.26089v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present Channel-wise Vector Quantization (CVQ), a novel image tokenization paradigm that replaces patch-wise tokens with channel-wise tokens. Unlike conventional vector quantization, which assigns a discrete token to each patch feature vector, CVQ quantizes each channel of the feature map. This represents an image as a 1D channel sequence with learnable coarse-to-fine ordering, rather than a 2D patch grid. Based on CVQ, we introduce a new visual autoregressive framework with "next-channel prediction". Instead of rendering images patch by patch in raster order, our Channel-wise Autoregressive (CAR) model predicts image channels sequentially, producing progressively enriched visual details. Specifically, it first sketches global structure and then refines fine-grained attributes, akin to a human artist's workflow. translated_title: 通道级向量量化：具有可学习排序的原生一维视觉标记化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了通道级向量量化，这是一种新颖的图像标记化范式，它用通道级标记取代了基于图像块的标记。与传统的为每个图像块特征向量分配一个离散标记的向量量化方法不同，CVQ对特征图的每个通道进行量化。这将图像表示为具有可学习的由粗到细排序的一维通道序列，而不是二维图像块网格。基于CVQ，我们引入了一种采用“下一通道预测”的新型视觉自回归框架。我们的通道级自回归模型不再按光栅顺序逐块渲染图像，而是依次预测图像通道，逐步生成更丰富的视觉细节。具体而言，它首先勾勒全局结构，然后再细化细粒度属性，类似于人类艺术家的工作流程。通过实验，我们证明：（1）CVQ表现出强大的码本可扩展性，在高达……的码本规模下仍保持95%以上的利用率（摘要在此处截断，后续内容未提供）。
tldr: 本文提出通道级向量量化（CVQ），通过量化特征图通道而非图像块，实现具有可学习由粗到细排序的原生一维视觉标记化，并据此构建了通过“下一通道预测”依次生成图像、先勾勒全局结构再细化细粒度细节的通道级自回归（CAR）模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Channel-wise Vector Quantization (CVQ), which quantizes feature map channels instead of image patches to achieve native 1D visual tokenization with learnable coarse-to-fine ordering, and introduces a Channel-wise Autoregressive (CAR) model that generates images via next-channel prediction, sketching global structure before progressively refining fine-grained details.
